chunks: May Allah send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the seal of the prophets, and the guide to the best of paths, and his pure family, and his companions who are the stars of conviction.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the supplication for Prophet Muhammad, his family, and companions in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This supplication, characteristic of Sharif al-Radi’s liturgical style in *Nahj al-Balagha*, emphasizes the theological hierarchy of guidance by linking the Prophet’s finality with the Ahl al-Bayt’s inherent purity (Taharah). It reflects the Shia emphasis on the inseparable bond between the Messenger and his Household as the enduring sources of certainty (Yaqin) for the community.
